$comment: Version references across the ubiquity network that are not package versions, ranges or .version files (release-version, version-match, the npm updates and the satellites step own those). `node scripts/release-references.mjs stamp` moves each to the release version (or removes it, for `delete`); `check` fails when one is behind; `scan` reports anything else still on the previous release line. Paths are relative to each repo's checkout under $HAXTHEWEB_ROOT.
